parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and designed to fit snugly on the pot’s rim.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, helping to cook food evenly and efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not move when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape with handles on the sides.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, providing the main volume for heating and boiling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or moved by the handles.
